scenes.text: The photograph was taken at noon, in full sun.
Three children stood in a row on the beach.
Three small shadows stretched out in front of them.
And one more, behind them, facing the wrong way.
None of them had anyone standing behind them.
Follow for more Quiet Horror Files.
